purpose: Single active source for subsequent route generation and tutorial navigation; historical route-input remains a frozen failure artifact.
coordinateScope: Registered original-body neutral world. OpenRB source frame must follow the board rigid transform selected by the head layout; this graph does not accept a new board pose.

motor-0-socket-74.evidence: Current OpenRB source connected component74: three 0.6mm square pin faces at local x16.1071/18.6071/21.1071, y11.99,z140.7375; pitch2.5; actual right-angle housing rim y12.69. Not board-bounds centre. Dimensions registered to source mesh, not manufacturer exact housing CAD.

motor-0-socket-110.evidence: Actual saved source component110 has three independent0.6mm square pin-end face vertex sets at2.5mm pitch; mouth is actual shroud outer-rim Y=-12.7100000381, row centre from middle pin. No board-bbox port surrogate.
motor-0-socket-110.expectedUse: OpenRB second physical TTL branch to motor10; same electrical bus, no increased-current inference

removedLegacyRoutes.reason: Cross-ankle jumper unnecessarily tethers independently moving feet. A separate OpenRB socket feeds motor10 and its descending leg chain.

socketIdentity: OpenRB sourceSocket74/110 are geometric connected-component identifiers, not official silkscreen port numbers.

electricalScope.bus: One TTL DYNAMIXEL bus; unchanged motor IDs
electricalScope.note: This physical branch graph does not authorize bridging isolated VDD supplies or reinterpret model strand colours as pin order.

sourceEvidence.supports: Four dedicated TTL DYNAMIXEL ports; EHR-03 mating housing; pins GND/VDD/DATA. Board port specification is 3000mA, not 3000mA multiplied by socket count.
sourceEvidence.decision: Use a second real port to remove the cross-foot jumper; exact routing is a project implementation decision.
